newsitem.title: GREECE: Alpha Invest to pay higher 96 dividend.
newsitem.headline: Alpha Invest to pay higher 96 dividend.

text.p: Greece's closed-end fund Alpha Investments said its 1996 profit rose 7.1 percent to 4.58 billion drachmas from 4.27 billion a year earlier.

The fund closed the year with unrealised capital gains of 1.31 billion drachmas and will propose a net dividend per share of 375 drachmas for 1996 to the upcoming annual shareholders meeting on April 10 1997.
It will be a 13.4 percent increase compared to the 1995 dividend of 330 drachmas, it said.

The fund's assets had a market value of 34.3 billion drachmas on December 12 1996 and 64 percent was invested in equities, 32 percent in fixed income and 4.0 percent in cash. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
